senses.gloss:
ví-manas, a. (having an away-removed
mind or heart, i. e.) out of one's senses or
disheartened. [1305.]

vimarda, m. destruction; (of sleep) disturbance.
 [√mṛd + vi.]

vimā́na, a. traversing, esp. the sky;
as m. n. a palatial car of the gods that
moves through the air, sky-chariot.
[√1mā + vi, ‘measure,’ q. v.: 1150.]
